scripts.sync:readme: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (fs.existsSync('../scripts/sync_portfolio_readme.js')) import('child_process').then(cp => cp.execSync('node ../scripts/sync_portfolio_readme.js', { stdio: 'inherit' })); else console.log('ℹ️ sync:readme skipped (standalone clone)'); });"
scripts.sync:all: npm run sync:readme && npm run sync:tokens
